data: Does the blue line in the leftmost plot reach a lower value than the red line?

The blue line represents DetachNorm, and the red line represents LayerNorm-simple. In the leftmost plot, which corresponds to the De-En dataset, the blue line (DetachNorm) is consistently above the red line (LayerNorm-simple). Therefore, the blue line does not reach a lower value than the red line.
